story.heading: Built on Trust. Delivered with Expertise.
paragraphs: Saanidhya Builders was founded in 2023 with a clear purpose — to bring professionalism, transparency, and quality craftsmanship to construction in Coimbatore.
Our strength lies in a well-balanced leadership structure that combines strategic business management with hands-on site execution expertise.
We don't just build structures — we build trust, value, and long-term relationships with every client we work with.

values.title: Trust & Transparency
values.desc: Clear communication, honest pricing, and no hidden costs — at every stage.

values.title: Quality Workmanship
values.desc: Premium materials and skilled execution with rigorous quality control on site.

values.title: Timely Completion
values.desc: Milestone-based planning and dedicated execution to deliver on time, every time.

values.title: Client-First Approach
values.desc: Your vision drives every decision — from first consultation to final handover.

mission: To deliver high-quality construction experiences built on trust, transparency, and timely completion — giving every client complete confidence from project start to handover.
vision: To become the most trusted name in construction across Coimbatore and Tamil Nadu — known for our integrity, professional approach, and the lasting quality of every structure we build.

team.name: Sandeep Kumar
team.bio: Sandeep leads business operations, client acquisition, and overall project coordination. He handles client requirements, legal documentation, budgeting, and ensures smooth communication from project initiation to final handover.
team.imageAlt: Sandeep Kumar - Business Head, Saanidhya Builders

team.name: Sankar
team.bio: Sankar heads construction execution and site operations. With hands-on field experience, he manages engineers, labor teams, materials, and daily site activities to ensure quality workmanship and structural standards.
